title: TERRA: Task-Oriented Edge AI for Regional Fire Detection with Identity-Free Reporting
abstract: arXiv:2610.37909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distributed fire-monitoring systems may involve many sensing devices reporting over a shared uplink, even though the operational objective is often to identify regions exhibiting evidence of fire rather than to recover device-specific measurements. We introduce TERRA (Task-Oriented Edge Representation and Regional Aggregation), an edge-AI framework that combines task-oriented local inference, identity-free region-tagged reporting, and permutation-invariant regional evidence aggregation. TERRA supports two reporting modes: TERRA-Score, in which each device communicates a quantized local fire probability, and TERRA-Feature, in which it communicates a compact learned representation for receiver-side aggregation using a permutation-invariant DeepSets model. translated_title: TERRA：面向任务的无身份报告区域火灾检测边缘人工智能
translated_abstract: 分布式火灾监控系统可能涉及大量传感设备通过共享上行链路进行报告，而实际运营目标往往是识别出现火灾证据的区域，而非恢复每个设备的具体测量值。我们提出了 TERRA（Task-Oriented Edge Representation and Regional Aggregation，任务导向的边缘表示与区域聚合），这是一个边缘人工智能框架，结合了面向任务的本地推理、无身份的区域标记报告以及排列不变的区域证据聚合。TERRA 支持两种报告模式：TERRA-Score，每个设备传输量化的本地火灾概率；以及 TERRA-Feature，设备传输紧凑的学习表示，供接收端使用排列不变的 DeepSets 模型进行聚合。我们以分布式室内 EN54 火灾报警数据集的全部 15 种数值传感模态作为概念验证测试平台，评估了针对事件级火灾场景的区域推理性能。（注：原摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: TERRA 提出一种边缘AI框架，通过无身份的区域标记报告和排列不变的区域证据聚合，将分布式火灾监测的重心从恢复单设备测量转向识别火灾发生的区域。
en_tdlr: TERRA is an edge-AI framework that shifts distributed fire monitoring from recovering device-specific measurements to identifying fire-affected regions, using identity-free region-tagged reporting and permutation-invariant regional evidence aggregation.
